title: Functional view of a smart city architecture: the SCDA greenfield approach

asserts: Smart cities are typical examples of distributed cyber-physical systems because they closely integrate multiple technical and social domains providing novel solutions to improve the cities' ecological footprint. Smart city architectures couple these domains and thus have to cover manifold control loops of different characteristic time constants. The wide granularity spectrum and multiple domains make modeling and simulation of smart cities a challenging task.
